From: Arun Moss
To: Tess Rowan
Date written: October 05, 1841
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10197
Arun Moss asked Tess Rowan to
send the harbor report.

From: Arun Moss
To: Tess Rowan
Date written: October 05, 1841
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10197
The depot reported receiving a
copy of the harbor report, but
the sender was not recorded.
